Eli (Design): Quick poll: compact settings modal — show inline errors on blur or only show summary on submit? Also deciding typed-confirm for deleting service accounts. Jin (Product): Hybrid: inline for single-field format errors, summary for cross-field/server errors. Keeps mobile clean. Rosa (Eng): Agreed. Implementation: inline = aria-live=polite; summary = role=\"alert\" + tabindex=\"-1\" and focus() on submit. Example:
Please fix 2 issues to save
. Ida (A11y): Asterisk alone insufficient. Add aria-required or explicit "(required)". Typed-confirm must include aria-describedby for instructions and Esc clears the input. Cam (DevEx): For typed-confirm: low friction case-insensitive by default, exactMatch flag for highest-risk. Recommend cooldown: 10s after 3 failed attempts. Undo toast for lightweight deletes: 10s + focusable Undo button. Jin (Product): Copy: summary headline: "Please fix X issues to save". Typed-confirm copy: "Type the service account name to confirm" + short warning line. Eli (Design): I'll make a tiny prototype (mobile + desktop) and show three confirm levels: toast undo, checkbox consent, typed-confirm (exact for keys). Please review by Thu noon. notify-bot: FYI: adding analytics events: validation.summary_shown, confirm.typed_attempt to backlog. Rosa (Eng): I'll draft props: allowExactMatch, cooldownMs, summaryFocusBehavior. Ida (A11y): I'll run VoiceOver/NVDA passes once prototype is up. Eli (Design): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
